subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should proactive fallback validation extend `openclaw models status --probe` as an ordered-chain mode, or be introduced as a distinct `models test-fallback` command with a matching slash action?
rationale: Both designs can solve the operator problem, but they create different public command contracts and overlap differently with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/63145; source inspection cannot determine the intended long-term UX.

options.title: Extend status probing
options.body: Add an ordered fallback-chain scope to the existing status probe so authentication, model health, and chain validation share one diagnostic surface.

options.title: Add a distinct command
options.body: Create `models test-fallback` and `/models test-fallback` when maintainers want chain execution to remain clearly separate from general model status checks.

recommendation.title: Extend status probing
recommendation.body: Add an ordered fallback-chain scope to the existing status probe so authentication, model health, and chain validation share one diagnostic surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and feature history show the strongest connection to fallback policy and model-status probe semantics.
